cases.root: All 48 result rows match after replacing only exact UTC-midnight first-of-month timestamps with DATE month keys; source date is DATE and the year predicate is calendar-equivalent.
cases.evidence: Frozen schema web_traffic.date=DATE; SQL uses DATE_TRUNC(month,date) and EXTRACT(YEAR)=2024; deterministic multiset comparison matched 48/48.
cases.deterministic: YES for saved business rows and E2E under the stated UTC-boundary rule
cases.limitation: No raw PostgreSQL result type metadata is retained; the comparator therefore accepts only zero-offset UTC midnight on day one.

cases.owner: SQL generation; secondary static validator coverage
cases.root: The generated AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivery_date - ship_date))) applies EXTRACT(EPOCH) to PostgreSQL DATE subtraction, which yields an integer day count; PostgreSQL rejects that type combination. The bounded repair still did not yield executable SQL.
cases.evidence: Observed SQL and UndefinedFunctionError; zero rows; one repair generation; raw audit FAIL.
cases.deterministic: YES for query invalidity; NO for the intended business result because no query completed
cases.limitation: Database error is an expected rejection of invalid generated SQL, not evidence of a database outage.

cases.owner: SQL Agent schema-selection/clarification integration; precise cause unresolved
cases.root: The schema-selection candidate pool includes commerce.orders, commerce.order_items and commerce.products, but final_selected_tables is null. The Agent then says orders is absent from the allowed table set and asks the user to add it or remove the delivered-status condition. The saved trace does not establish whether the selector failed to produce a final set or the clarification path misread the candidate list.
cases.evidence: Saved schema_selection.method=decision_model_top_five; candidate_tables includes the three required tables; final_selected_tables=null; schema_selector_status=available; no SQL generated; answer claims commerce.orders is not allowed and offers to remove the status condition or add orders.

cases.limitation: The output is misleading because dropping status changes the requested population; candidate tables are not proof they were finally selected.
